label: MARKETING TERM
headline: Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
body: SEO is the process of making your website or online content more visible when people search for things on Google and other search engines.
caption:
Think about what words your ideal customer might type into a search engine to find someone like you. By using those words naturally on your website, blog, or product descriptions, you help search engines understand what you offer.
